title: Actions Taken by SkillsFuture Singapore in light of Lapses in Disbursement of Grants
what_it_is: Actions Taken by SkillsFuture Singapore in light of Lapses in Disbursement of Grants

sections.label: SSG grant disbursement overpayments
sections.summary: AGO found lapses in SSG's grant disbursement leading to estimated overpayments of about $4.22 million from 1 April 2018 to 30 June 2021.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: First, AGO found lapses in SSG’s disbursement of grants, which led to estimated overpayments of about $4.22 million between 1 April 2018 and 30 June 2021.

sections.label: SSG SDL variance follow-up
sections.summary: AGO found SSG did not follow up adequately on a $43 million variance between estimated Skills Development Levy payable and collected for 2015 to 2020.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Separately, AGO found that SSG did not follow up adequately, on a variance of $43 million, between SSG’s estimate of the Skills Development Levy (SDL) that employers should pay and what was collected for the period 2015 to 2020.

sections.label: SDL variance decline
sections.summary: The overall variance between estimated SDL payable and actual payments fell from 18% in 2008 to 3% to 4%, with most companies compliant today.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The overall variance between the estimated SDL payable and the actual payments has fallen from 18% of overall SDL collected in 2008, to the current 3% to 4%, with the majority of companies compliant in paying their levy today.

sections.label: SSG engaging affected employers
sections.summary: SSG will give affected employers time to validate amounts owed and will contact all of them by the end of the financial year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: SSG will give affected employers time to validate the amounts owed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: It has started engaging the affected employers and will contact all of them by the end of the financial year.

sections.label: AGO sampling checks and verification
sections.summary: The speaker does not know if checks were 100%, says AGO normally samples, and notes overpayments are still being verified with entities involved.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: At the moment, I do not know if it was 100% checks, but to my knowledge, AGO normally does sampling checks over a period of time and in this case, they had checked for the grant disbursed between the period of 1 April 2018 and June 2021, I believe.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Actually, these overpayments are still in the process of being verified with the entities involved.

sections.label: Service provider human errors
sections.summary: Human errors were found in the service provider's manual processing, and SSG will look through contractual terms and KPIs the provider is liable for.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: As to whether actions will be taken against the service provider, indeed, we discovered some human errors in the manual processing by the service provider.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: There are contractual terms and key performance indicators (KPIs) that the service provider is liable for and SSG will be looking through this.

sections.label: Unascertained $4.22 million fraud
sections.summary: It has not been ascertained whether the $4.22 million pointed out by AGO is fraud.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Actually, it has not been ascertained if the $4.22 million that AGO pointed out is fraud.

sections.label: 2017 fraud and false claims
sections.summary: In 2017 a syndicate committed $40 million in fraud, and 4,400 individuals made false SkillsFuture Credit claims and were arrested.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: I think the most significant one was in 2017.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: There was a syndicate that was found to have committed fraud amounting to $40 million.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Besides that, similarly in 2017, there was a discovery of 4,400 individuals who made false claims for SkillsFuture Credit and that was also discovered and arrested back then.

sections.label: MOE and SSG SkillsFuture commitment
sections.summary: MOE and SSG remain committed to providing sufficient and timely SkillsFuture support and grants to individuals and companies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: MOE and SSG remain committed to providing sufficient and timely SkillsFuture support and grant to individuals as well as companies.
